verdict.rationale: The axis applies, because Isaac ROS targets real robots on Jetson. However, the evidence shows only ROS 2 packages for perception, navigation, manipulation and teleoperation, plus simulation scripting. These are developer building blocks, not a documented flow where an AI agent authenticates with scoped credentials and commands a real robot end-to-end. Nothing in the pack covers credentials, auth scoping, or an agent-facing control API, and probes found no OpenAPI spec.
